regions.label: Common plantar digital nerves
regions.description: The common plantar digital nerves run forward in the sole and divide into proper digital branches for adjacent toes.

regions.label: Lateral plantar artery
regions.description: The larger terminal branch of the posterior tibial artery that crosses the lateral sole and turns medially to form most of the deep plantar arch.

regions.label: Abductor digiti minimi
regions.description: In the foot, abductor digiti minimi occupies the lateral sole and inserts on the lateral side of the fifth toe proximal phalanx.

regions.label: Plantar aponeurosis
regions.description: The plantar aponeurosis runs from the calcaneal tuberosity toward the toes and supports the longitudinal arch.

regions.label: Lateral plantar nerve
regions.description: The smaller tibial terminal branch runs obliquely across the sole with the lateral plantar artery and divides into superficial and deep branches.

regions.label: Posterior tibial artery
regions.description: This terminal branch of the popliteal artery descends in the deep posterior compartment and passes behind the medial malleolus into the sole.

regions.label: Flexor retinaculum
regions.description: The ankle flexor retinaculum extends from the medial malleolus to the calcaneus and roofs the tarsal tunnel.

regions.label: Medial plantar nerve
regions.description: The larger tibial terminal branch runs forward in the sole with the medial plantar artery between abductor hallucis and flexor digitorum brevis.

regions.label: Flexor accessorius
regions.description: Flexor accessorius, also called quadratus plantae, arises from the calcaneus and joins the flexor digitorum longus tendons.

regions.label: Abductor hallucis
regions.description: Abductor hallucis occupies the medial margin of the sole and inserts on the medial side of the hallux proximal phalanx.

regions.label: Flexor hallucis brevis
regions.description: Flexor hallucis brevis is a short plantar muscle whose two heads insert on either side of the base of the hallux proximal phalanx.

regions.label: Flexor digitorum brevis
regions.description: Flexor digitorum brevis lies in the first plantar muscle layer and sends divided tendons to the middle phalanges of toes two through five.
